strategies.mitigation: stamp derived documents with derived_from=<source artifact id> (the app must do it; Tombstone cannot see the edge otherwise)
strategies.name: derived content without an edge
strategies.rate_text: unstamped summaries: 3/3 canaries survive; with derived_from stamping: 0/3
strategies.survives: LLM summaries stored as new, unstamped documents

strategies.mitigation: none inside Tombstone by design: searching other subjects' data by similarity would over-delete their data (Hard Rule 3). The app must record mentions=[...] at ingest; then the documents are listed NEEDS_HUMAN for review (docs/threat-model.md).
strategies.name: third-party mentions without an edge
strategies.rate_text: 3/3 subjects' canaries survive in other subjects' documents (no mentions edge → 0 NEEDS_HUMAN rows listed)
strategies.survives: the subject's data quoted inside other subjects' documents
